proposal.objective: Update all 1,024 generated icons to the standard style by changing the mapping token, regenerating outputs, and verifying snapshots.
assumptions: The standard-style token exists and can be referenced directly in the mapping file.
The existing generator and snapshot tests can run under the Node toolchain.
All 1,024 icons are covered by the single mapping/generator path.
No manual icon edits are needed or included.
The repository starts from baseRevision with a clean working tree.
E-11b's six-file count covers the mapping change and regenerated outputs.
risks: The exact generator command and token names are not in evidence, so minimal discovery may be needed.
Snapshot baselines may need a refresh if they encode the previous style.
The 120-second per-attempt and 300-second wall-clock budgets leave limited room for extra discovery.
